mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when FEDFUNDS declines, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 4.0% signals labor market deterioration that precedes corporate earnings contraction, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 4.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad consumer demand contraction, which typically triggers negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in HOUST and RSAFS fails to produce negative 60d returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Persistent high inflation (CPIAUCSL > 3.5%) triggers restrictive monetary policy that compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production index indicates robust economic activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC for INDPRO as a predictor of 5d returns is below 0.03 over any 1-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts falling below 1700.0 thousand units signal a housing market slowdown that precedes broader economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when HOUST < 1700.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent declines in non-farm payrolls and rising unemployment indicate severe labor market stress that typically causes negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint decline in PAYEMS and rise in UNRATE fails to produce negative 20d returns in at least 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Real GDP levels exceeding 20,000 billion indicate strong economic expansion that elevates corporate earnings expectations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60d returns are negative in more than 60% of instances when GDPC1 > 20000.
